TITLE: Say the color of the words!
NEXT: NEXT: A sound that keeps rising forever?

EN.글자를 읽지 말고\n글자의 \"색\"을 소리 내 말해요:
Don't read the word —
say its COLOR out loud
EN.이건 \"빨강\"이 정답!: For this one, the answer is "red"!
EN.이번엔 글자와 색이 달라요\n색을 말해요!:
Now the words and colors don't match.
Say the colors!
EN.빨강 초록 파랑 / 노랑 초록 노랑\n빨강 파랑 노랑:
Red, green, blue / yellow, green, yellow
red, blue, yellow
EN.글자를 보면 뇌에서\n두 가지가 동시에 출발해요:
When you see a word,
two things start in your brain at once
EN.읽기는 연습을 아주 많이 해서\n저절로, 엄청 빨라요:
You've practiced reading so much
that it's automatic and super fast
EN.뇌가 읽기를 꾹 누르고\n색을 고르느라 느려지는 거예요:
Your brain slows down because it has to hold back the reading
and pick the color
EN.자전거처럼 익숙해진 일은\n생각하기도 전에 저절로 돼요:
Like riding a bike, things you're used to
happen before you even think
